annotations.title: Tailor my CV to a job

description: Creates a new saved CV optimised for one job: the summary and experience bullets are reworded in the job's language without adding employers, titles, dates, tools, skills or numbers that are not already in the CV, and relevant skills move first. Returns keyword coverage before and after, the exact changes, and job keywords the CV does not evidence. Skills the user confirms are passed as confirmedSkills.

confirmedSkills.description: Skills the user confirmed they genuinely have.

instructions.description: Optional user preferences, e.g. 'keep it to one page'.

jobId.description: Jobiba job ID (the id field from search_jobs or list_my_jobs).

resumeId.description: Base resume to tailor (defaults to the latest, or built from the profile).

name: tailor_resume_for_job
title: Tailor my CV to a job
